DRAFT ANALYSIS: Edge capture vs. aggregate optimization (OP-16-J-edge)  
---  
**Metric:** `edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_winning_days) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_losing_days))` is the sole source-of-truth for trade approval. Aggregate Sharpe/P&L are secondary tiebreakers.  
**Current state:** Winners (4/29 SPY 710P ×6, 5/01 SPY 721P ×20, 5/04 SPY 721P ×10) show +$1,542 edge capture. Losers (5/05 SPY 722P ×20, etc.) show −$775 loss. `edge_capture = 1,542 − 775 = +$767` (50% of max possible 1,542).  
**Decision:** Candidates with edge_capture < 771 (50% threshold) are REJECTED regardless of aggregate Sharpe.
